opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. The next application round is open, closing 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: A fund in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft supporting postdoctoral researchers with additional support to unlock their potential. The next application round is open, closing 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting knowledge transfer and impact activities.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences. Applications have closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.
